# Pdf

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Entry point for the BonniePDF fluent API. Provides a static factory method for creating PDF documents with a fluent, chainable syntax.

Namespace `BonniePDF.Fluent`.

## Methods

- [`Create`](#create): Creates a new PDF document using the fluent API.

### `Create`

```csharp
PdfBuilder Create(Action<PdfBuilder> handler)
```

*static*

Creates a new PDF document using the fluent API.

- `handler`: A delegate that configures the document using the fluent API.

Example:

```csharp
Pdf.Create(doc => { doc.Page(page => { page.Size(PdfSize.A4); page.Margin(40); page.Content().Column(col => { col.Item().Text("Hello World").FontSize(24).Bold(); }); }); }).Save("hello.pdf");
```
